name: JWT Decoder
tagline: See what's inside a JSON Web Token, check its expiry, and verify HMAC signatures.
seoTitle: JWT decoder that never sends your token anywhere
description: Decode a JWT's header and claims, see when it expires, and verify HS256 signatures with your secret. Your token never leaves the page.

specs.Verifies: HS256, HS384, HS512 with a shared secret

faq.q: Is it safe to paste a real token?
faq.a: Safer than most: it's decoded in this tab and the page's security policy blocks any outside connection. Still, treat live tokens like passwords and revoke any you've shared.
Not yet. Those need the issuer's public key; HMAC tokens (HS256 and friends) can be checked with your secret now.
